text: Confidential presentation from the Collective Bargaining Team respecting Collective Bargaining City of Toronto, CUPE Local 79, TCEU Local 416 and CUPE Local 2998.

The Collective Bargaining Subcommittee: 1. Confirmed the actions of the Subcommittee in closed session in issuing instructions to staff. 2. Directed that the confidential presentation (September 6, 2019) from the Chief People Officer, People and Equity and the Director, Employee and Labour Relations remain confidential in its entirety as it pertains to labour relations or employee negotiations.
